Learn to explain what happens when decoding goes wrong: DecodingError, decodeIfPresent & Date Decoding Strategy, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
DecodingError - The error type that tells you why decoding failed, like a missing key or a wrong type.
decodeIfPresent - A decoding method that returns nil instead of failing when a key is missing.
Date Decoding Strategy - A setting that tells the decoder how to turn JSON text into a Date.

landscape.title: iOS DecodingError, decodeIfPresent & Date Decoding Strategy | Day 200
landscape.description:
Explain DecodingError, decodeIfPresent & Date Decoding Strategy in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
DecodingError, decodeIfPresent, Date Decoding Strategy 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

DecodingError - The error type that tells you why decoding failed, like a missing key or a wrong type.
한국어: DecodingError: 키가 없거나 타입이 틀린 것처럼 디코딩이 실패한 이유를 알려 주는 에러 타입

decodeIfPresent - A decoding method that returns nil instead of failing when a key is missing.
한국어: decodeIfPresent: 키가 없을 때 실패하지 않고 nil을 돌려주는 디코딩 메서드

Date Decoding Strategy - A setting that tells the decoder how to turn JSON text into a Date.
한국어: Date Decoding Strategy: JSON 텍스트를 Date로 바꾸는 방법을 디코더에 알려 주는 설정

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about what happens when decoding goes wrong, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain DecodingError, decodeIfPresent and Date Decoding Strategy in English?

dialogue.title: Missing key

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the app fails when the server forgets the `nick` key.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Decoding throws a DecodingError. Read it, because it says which key is missing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So DecodingError tells me why decoding failed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes: a missing key, a wrong type, or bad data.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But `nick` is optional. I want nil, not an error.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then use decodeIfPresent. It returns nil when the key is missing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I write decodeIfPresent myself for `String?`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not usually. The compiler uses it for optional properties.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the dates? The server sends text, not a Date.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set a date decoding strategy. It tells the decoder how to turn the text into a Date.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So `iso8601` is our date decoding strategy?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Set it on the decoder before you decode.
Print the DecodingError to see which key is missing.
